what: Plan launches tiers with --description-text but does not specify one of the required prompt-source flags
scenario_or_breakage: Real Codex Cursor and Claude launcher calls exit 2 before producing output, while the proposed stub harness can still pass if stubs only honor --output
suggested_fix: Revise the launch step to pass the composed prompt via --prompt-file "$prompt_file" or --prompt "$prompt_content", and make launcher stubs assert exactly one prompt source is present

what: --plan-file is independent from the file ACTION=EMIT_PLAN validates
scenario_or_breakage: An ad-hoc caller can revise a supplied plan path while design-driver refreshes diff-lines.txt from $DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan.txt, so the emit-plan gate can validate the wrong file
suggested_fix: Preflight that canonical --plan-file equals "$design_tmpdir/plan.txt", or drop the independent plan path and derive it from --design-tmpdir

what: Plan relies on git apply --unsafe-paths as if it provided a plan.txt allowlist
scenario_or_breakage: An LLM patch can include another existing repo or absolute path and git apply may mutate it before the snapshot restore logic restores only plan.txt
suggested_fix: Add explicit unified-diff path validation before --check and apply: every ---/+++ path must resolve to the target plan file, reject any other path, and add a harness case for an existing sibling file

what: --patch-format file-replacement adds a second patch pipeline for future optionality rather than current acceptance needs
scenario_or_breakage: The SIMPLE lane now has duplicate validation/apply logic and a public knob Piece 5 may need to account for even though unified diff is selected as the mainline
suggested_fix: Keep only unified-diff for this piece unless the feature explicitly requires replacement mode; defer file-replacement to a follow-up if unified diffs prove brittle
